workflow: A text decoder parses a numeric field using a native integer conversion routine and prepares fallback checks for range or trailing-input errors.
The conversion path leaves an error-status value or related result metadata marked as uninitialized under memory instrumentation.
The decoder reads that value while deciding whether to accept the parsed number or use an alternate conversion path.
The instrumentation reports an uninitialized read during otherwise valid decoding, causing the instrumented operation to fail instead of completing normally.
summary: Uninitialized conversion-status read during numeric decoding
decision_reason: This is distinct from the existing uninitialized-storage cluster: the reported mechanism involves conversion-result or error-status metadata observed as uninitialized, not reading an unused numeric storage unit from a zero-valued object.
